concepts.title: Prime ideal
concepts.definition_md: A proper ideal $P$ of $R$ is prime if $ab \in P$ implies $a \in P$ or $b \in P$.
concepts.assumptions: R is a commutative ring with identity.

concepts.title: Maximal ideal
concepts.definition_md: A proper ideal $M$ of $R$ is maximal if there is no ideal strictly between $M$ and $R$.
concepts.assumptions: R is a commutative ring with identity.
